definition.interpretation: The invalid_measurement result stems from the simplistic reliance on random seeding for state divergence metrics, which failed to capture meaningful path-dependent memory accumulation as intended by the hypothesis.
definition.limitations: Current simulation lacks a robust state-dependence mechanism; seeds are insufficient to model intelligent system memory dynamics.
definition.next_step: Refine the experiment to incorporate iterative state updating rather than static seed-based divergence.

definition.reason: Previous experimental implementation failed validation; hypothesis hyp-divergent-values-002 requires a robust test to substantiate claims regarding path-dependent divergence.
definition.stop: Failure to demonstrate actionable divergence patterns after two further iterations.
definition.uncertainty: The extent to which simple Python-based simulations can capture emergent value divergence is unknown.
